bug_semantics: For layout, render, and include lookups, LiquidJS treated the configured root/partials/layouts directories as a filesystem boundary but its final Node fallback called require.resolve(file) and yielded the returned absolute path without applying the containment check used for ordinary candidates. An attacker who controls template text or, with the default dynamicPartials=true, a partial-name variable can therefore supply an absolute or traversing path; if require.resolve resolves it, Loader.lookup accepts and reads a file outside the configured directories.
flaw_origin: Commit 2dd43559b585fe42069e94197fb5aa2ee32ad616 introduced the mechanism itself: src/fs/node.ts added a fallback that returns require.resolve(file), src/fs/ifs.ts exposed that fallback, and src/liquid.ts appended its result directly to the candidate paths with no root validation. Later commits 24f534608489fccc155f30bbaf37397c46278da6 and b9ae479b653a34fadb98c324c4683dd1fdd31af1 only moved the same unguarded fallback into lookupFiles() and then src/fs/loader.ts; a3455ebd0b207141c34630c0af44d917db2ca1dd added containment to ordinary partial/layout candidates but left the fallback bypass intact.
ai_marker: absent: the exact BIC commit object names author harttle <yangjvn@126.com> and committer harttle <yangjvn@126.com>; its complete message is 'feat: support require.resolve for lookup, see #168' and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, AI reference, or other trailer.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/harttle/liquidjs/security/advisories/GHSA-wmfp-5q7x-987x states affected <10.25.0, patched 10.25.0, and identifies the unbounded require.resolve fallback; disclosure PR https://github.com/harttle/liquidjs/pull/851 gives the dynamic include PoC and identifies src/fs/loader.ts, while fix PR https://github.com/harttle/liquidjs/pull/855 and https://github.com/harttle/liquidjs/commit/3cd024d652dc883c46307581e979fe32302adbac are the maintainer's fix. `git log -S 'fallback(file)' -- src/liquid.ts ...` finds 2dd43559b585fe42069e94197fb5aa2ee32ad616 as the first addition; its diff adds require.resolve in src/fs/node.ts and the unchecked candidate append in src/liquid.ts. Direct-parent tree inspection (`git show 5492fb0b173f8989d6c237883c374e271d2adb4d:src/fs/ifs.ts`, `:src/fs/node.ts`, and `:src/liquid.ts`) proves there is no fallback interface member, no require.resolve fallback, and no fallback candidate append. `git log -L` traces the pre-fix src/fs/loader.ts block through b9ae479b653a34fadb98c324c4683dd1fdd31af1 to the earlier src/liquid.ts implementation, and `git log -S` crosses that move to the true BIC. Tag checks show the BIC first appears in v9.3.0 (tag commit 390cd23f5ff10754a667fe5aabffec0b915651e0; v9.2.0 at 1ecff1c341df6385c603663f54b504c6dd0cf4a6 does not contain this BIC), so the advisory's <10.25.0 range is coarse before this particular fallback mechanism existed. The last vulnerable boundary v10.24.0 is tag commit 906707833e196733e592ca52fbe5eda48b71a8a6 and still has `if (filepath !== undefined) yield filepath` in src/fs/loader.ts. `git tag --contains 3cd024d652dc883c46307581e979fe32302adbac` starts at v10.25.0 (tag commit 93c38c7c6d1f3e4a3c64fc5f205cf6bff4be46a6), and the v10.24.0..v10.25.0 diff replaces the unchecked yield with `filepath !== undefined && isAllowed(filepath)`. The PR's first direct corrective member, https://github.com/harttle/liquidjs/commit/ee24d648facdb0ee7fcd05707d67dd74a1e539e4, adds the missing `!enforceRoot || dirs.some(dir => this.contains(dir, filepath))` guard; mainline received its squashed/final form in 3cd024d652dc883c46307581e979fe32302adbac. Exact BIC-only AI inspection used `git cat-file -p 2dd43559b585fe42069e94197fb5aa2ee32ad616`.
reasoning: The advisory and reporter PoC establish the vulnerable sink and attack path: untrusted include/render/layout names reach the loader, ordinary candidates are constrained for partial/layout lookup, but the default Node fallback can resolve an arbitrary absolute/traversing path and bypass that constraint. History must cross two later code moves: b9ae479b653a34fadb98c324c4683dd1fdd31af1 created src/fs/loader.ts from existing logic, and 24f534608489fccc155f30bbaf37397c46278da6 had already moved the fallback inside src/liquid.ts. The earliest content-changing origin is therefore 2dd43559b585fe42069e94197fb5aa2ee32ad616, which simultaneously created require.resolve fallback and consumed its result without validation; its immediate parent lacks every component of that fallback path. The BIC predates the earliest tag containing it, v9.3.0, and remains ancestral to v10.24.0. The mainline fix 3cd024d652dc883c46307581e979fe32302adbac is first contained by the patched v10.25.0 tag and applies one isAllowed containment predicate to relative, ordinary, and fallback candidates; ee24d648facdb0ee7fcd05707d67dd74a1e539e4 is the direct PR commit that first wrote the fallback guard. The BIC is an ordinary single-parent commit, not a squash, and its exact commit object has only a human author/committer and no AI marker, so the causal verdict is NOT_AI.
